ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure shows a logic circuit block, with “&” marked inside, indicating the AND logic part; the upper and middle two input lines on the left are both labeled “1”. There is also an input labeled “1” at the lower left, connected to the enable terminal marked EN, and there is a small circle before this enable terminal, indicating that this enable is active-low. The output terminal on the right is labeled F and has a tri-state output/buffer output symbol. Then reason: When the upper two AND logic inputs are both 1, the AND logic itself will produce a valid logic 1; but whether the output is driven also depends on the enable terminal. Since the EN terminal has an inversion small circle, it is an active-low enable, and the output is enabled only when EN=0. In the figure the EN input is 1, therefore the tri-state output is disabled. When the tri-state output is disabled, it drives neither 0 nor 1, but is in a high-impedance state.

method.method_draft: First inspect the circuit symbols: the upper two inputs to the AND section are both logic 1, but the lower enable input EN is also logic 1 and enters through a bubble, indicating an active-low enable. Convert the enable condition: active-low EN is asserted only when EN = 0, so with EN = 1 the output buffer is disabled. Since a disabled tri-state output does not drive either 0 or 1, conclude that F is in the high-impedance state.

再推理：上方两个与逻辑输入均为 1 时，与逻辑本身会产生有效的逻辑 1；但输出是否被驱动还取决于使能端。由于 EN 端有反相小圆圈，它是低有效使能，只有 EN=0 时输出才被使能。图中 EN 输入为 1，因此三态输出被禁止。三态输出被禁止时既不驱动 0 也不驱动 1，而是处于高阻态。
